# tests/test_interleave.py
import pytest

from your_module import interleave  # replace with the module where interleave is defined


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3], ["a", "b", "c"], [1, "a", 2, "b", 3, "c"], id="same_length"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3, 4], ["a", "b"], [1, "a", 2, "b", 3, 4], id="a_longer"),
        pytest.param([1], ["a", "b", "c"], [1, "a", "b", "c"], id="b_longer"),
        pytest.param([], [], [], id="both_empty"),
        pytest.param([1, 2], [], [1, 2], id="b_empty"),
        pytest.param([], ["a", "b"], ["a", "b"], id="a_empty"),
        pytest.param(
            [None, False, 0],
            ["", []],
            [None, "", False, [], 0],
            id="falsy_values_and_falsy_a_tail",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            ["x"],
            [0, False, None],
            ["x", 0, False, None],
            id="falsy_b_tail",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_interleave_returns_expected_result(a, b, expected):
    assert interleave(a, b) == expected


def test_interleave_does_not_mutate_inputs():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    b = ["a", "b"]

    original_a = a.copy()
    original_b = b.copy()

    result = interleave(a, b)

    assert result == [1, "a", 2, "b", 3]
    assert a == original_a
    assert b == original_b


def test_interleave_returns_new_list_when_one_input_is_empty():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    b = []

    result = interleave(a, b)

    assert result == [1, 2, 3]
    assert result is not a
    assert result is not b


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("a", "b"),
    [
        pytest.param(None, [], id="a_is_none"),
        pytest.param([], None, id="b_is_none"),
        pytest.param(123, [1], id="a_not_iterable"),
        pytest.param([1], 123, id="b_not_iterable"),
        pytest.param(iter([1, 2]), [3, 4], id="a_iterator_no_slicing"),
        pytest.param([1, 2], iter([3, 4]), id="b_iterator_no_len"),
        pytest.param({1, 2}, [3, 4], id="a_iterable_but_not_sliceable"),
        pytest.param([1, 2], {3, 4}, id="b_iterable_but_not_sliceable"),
    ],
)
def test_interleave_invalid_inputs_raise_type_error(a, b):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        interleave(a, b)
